units.source_text: 云居雁去后，太君写一封信给她，信中说：

en.t: After Kumoi no Kari had gone away, the grandmother wrote her a letter, saying:

units.source_text: “你父亲恐又将恨我，但你总了解我的心情，盼即来此相见。”

en.t: “Your father will probably hate me again, but you always understand how I feel. I hope you will come here at once so we may meet.”

units.source_text: 云居雁果然打扮得花枝招展地来了。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari did indeed come, dressed in splendid finery.

units.source_text: 她今年十四岁，似乎尚未成人，然而娇憨温柔，容颜十分妩媚。

en.t: She was fourteen that year and still seemed not quite grown up, yet she was sweetly innocent and gentle, with an exceedingly charming face.

units.source_text: 祖母对她说道：“我一向与你寸步不离，朝夕相伴，你去了我好冷清啊！

en.t: Her grandmother said to her, “I have always been inseparable from you, keeping you beside me morning and evening. Now that you have gone, I am terribly lonely.

units.source_text: 我残年无多，常常担心：不知道命里有否看见你荣华富贵之一日。

en.t: I have little of my life left, and I often worry whether fate will let me live to see the day when you enjoy honor and prosperity.

units.source_text: 如今你又舍我而去，我真伤心啊！”

en.t: And now you have left me again and gone away. It truly breaks my heart!”

units.source_text: 说到这里，哭起来了。

en.t: Having said this, she began to weep.

units.source_text: 云居雁想起了最近那件难为情的事，头也抬不起来，只是嘤嘤啜泣。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari remembered that recent embarrassing matter and could not even raise her head; she only sobbed softly.

units.source_text: 此时夕雾的乳母宰相君来了。

en.t: Just then Yugiri's nurse, Saisho no Kimi, arrived.

units.source_text: 她悄悄地对云居雁说：“我但愿小姐做了我的女主人。

en.t: She quietly said to Kumoi no Kari, “I only wish, my lady, that you might become my mistress.

units.source_text: 小姐迁往那边去了，实在可惜啊。

en.t: It is truly a pity that you have moved over there.

units.source_text: 舅老爷要将小姐许配他人，小姐切不可听从啊！”

en.t: Your uncle means to marry you off to someone else, but you must absolutely not obey him!”

units.source_text: 云居雁越发怕羞了，一句话也不回答。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari grew even more bashful and did not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 太君对宰相君说：“罢了！

en.t: The grandmother said to Saisho no Kimi, “Enough!

units.source_text: 这种没趣的话不必说了。

en.t: There is no need to say such dispiriting things.

units.source_text: 各人的命运都是前世注定的啊！”

en.t: Everyone's fate is fixed by deeds from a former life!”

units.source_text: 宰相君还是怒气冲冲地说：“不是这么说的！

en.t: Saisho no Kimi, still angry, said, “That is not the way of it!

units.source_text: 舅老爷恐怕是看不起我家少爷，说他微不足道呢！

en.t: Your uncle must be looking down on our young lord and saying that he amounts to nothing!

units.source_text: 我倒要请他打听打听：我家少爷哪一点赶不上别人？”

en.t: I would like to have him inquire for himself: in what way is our young lord inferior to anyone else?”
